# Scoop schema

`scoop.schema.json` is an unmodified copy of [Scoop's official manifest schema](https://github.com/ScoopInstaller/Scoop/blob/e6aa3b366bdee8ed138c1e0f7b85192ebdd35d0f/schema.json), pinned to commit `e6aa3b366bdee8ed138c1e0f7b85192ebdd35d0f`.

The upstream license is included in `Scoop.LICENSE`. To update the schema, copy `schema.json` and `LICENSE` from the same reviewed Scoop commit, update this reference, and run the manifest validation and its tests.
